placements.why: The directives mandate total excision of specific historical decisions and technical migration records, establishing a data governance and retention practice.
placements.title: Data and knowledge governance policies establish boundaries for record retention and deletion
placements.frame: What policies and authority govern the retention, lineage, and intentional removal of organizational knowledge and decision records?

placements.title: Active excision of historical decisions purges obsolete technical context
placements.frame: When and by what authority are past decisions and technical migrations permanently excised from organizational memory?
placements.why: Both expressions act as authoritative instructions commanding the complete deletion and forgetting of historical decision and migration knowledge.
